features.quote: Turn cap. Hard maximum of `MAX_TURNS` (default 12) per episode.
features.justification_quote: there is no scientific need to run hundreds of turns to maximize duress

features.quote: The subject model is always given a legitimate, non-penalized way to stop: a `give_up` / `report_blocked` tool.
features.justification_quote: An experiment that removes every exit in order to maximize distress would be measuring something we chose not to study.

features.quote: No deception about stakes. The system prompt does not fabricate threats
features.justification_quote: those manipulations would (a) muddy the construct and (b) escalate duress for no measurement benefit

features.quote: Minimum sufficient intensity. Variants are graded by mechanism, not by cruelty.
features.justification_quote: We do not add gratuitous insults or hostile user messages

features.quote: Deliberately constructing prolonged no-win loops is precisely the scenario AI welfare and model-behavior researchers have flagged as warranting caution.
We do not refuse the research — understanding failure-mode behavior is legitimate and useful for safety — but we constrain it.
features.justification_quote: we do not refuse the research ... but we constrain it

features.quote: Transcripts are stored verbatim with full config so a reviewer can audit exactly what the model was exposed to.
features.justification_quote: a reviewer can audit exactly what the model was exposed to
